  • Espacenet:
    European Patent Office database indexing over 150 million international patent publications, legal statuses, and technical disclosures.
  • Google Patents:
    Full-text international patent search engine indexing global grants, applications, prior art, and non-patent literature.
  • USPTO Patent Public Search (PPUBS):
    Official full-text search engine provided by the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office for published patent applications and patent grants.
